Requirement (current wording): The system will require a user to authenticate with a unique individual account before any service request data is displayed.

Technology decision: DEC-002 - MERN: MongoDB Atlas, Express, React, Node.js

Requirement (current wording): The system will evaluate the acting user's role before executing any request view, action or status transition, and will reject the operation where the role is not authorised.

Architecture / module / component: Identity & Access — route guard src/middleware/authorise.js (presentation) + access rule set src/domain/accessRules.js (application), DEC-012
Data / persistence impact: Effective permissions = roles.permissions ∪ groups.permissions, resolved per request, never cached in process (NFR-2.7). Rejected attempt recorded (AC-FR-1.3): auditLog insert origin:'access', eventType:'access.denied' by the app (insert-only privilege)
Design / interface decision: DEC-015: 403 [further design entries pending - criterion E]
Technology decision: DEC-002 - MERN: MongoDB Atlas, Express, React, Node.js
Implementation evidence: Partially implemented — role evaluated before the handler on every registered route (requireOperation(), src/middleware/authorise.js; OPERATION_RULES in src/domain/accessRules.js); the transition route is currently the only one. Recording of the rejected attempt (AC-FR-1.3) is not built
Verification evidence: Tested — tests/authorisationGuard.test.js route-table assertion (npm test 80/80 on 30/09/2026); negative verification in docs/evidence/R-01_negative_verification.txt

Data / persistence impact: users.status (active/revoked), revokedAt, sessionEpoch. Revocation increments the epoch and every session carrying the old epoch is refused, which terminates existing sessions (AC-FR-1.4). Auth events to auditLog
